trial.evidence: "Snag a free Premium pass. 7 days, risk-free!" on the web pricing page; the App Store description says "start your free Premium trial today"

ourRead: Monthly, $19.99, anchors Annual: 12 months cost $239.88, so $79.99 saves 67%. A year also costs "about the same as 1 hour with a nutrition expert".
All 5 buttons say START FREE TRIAL, and 4 open the Annual checkout, as does "Claim offer". Monthly gets one outlined button.
The App Store text names 2 tiers, Premium and Premium Plus, but all 10 listed items are Premium. The web sells $79.99 a year and $19.99 a month; the App Store adds $49.99 a year and $9.99 a month.

improvements.title: Put the 7 days on the button
improvements.detail: All 5 buttons say "START FREE TRIAL"; the 7 days sit in the top banner and in a closed FAQ answer. Print "Start 7 days free" on the Annual button and "Then $79.99 a year" under it.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Trade both badges for $6.67 a month
improvements.detail: The same Annual card says "Best value!" under the 8/10, then "Most popular!" in the plan picker. Swap both tags for its monthly cost, $6.67, next to Monthly's $19.99.
improvements.rule: Delete filler badges ("New", "AI-powered", "Beta") unless they change a decision.

improvements.title: Fill the plan sections with flat blue
improvements.detail: The plan sections fade from the icon blue, #0066EE, to lavender #8A81FA at the bottom left. Fill them with flat #0066EE, so yellow stays the one bright color.

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in MyFitnessPal's style. Top to bottom: a bold headline, then a rounded card per plan, Annual first. Each card holds the plan name, a big yearly or monthly price, a billing line and a full-width pill button. Annual adds 3 checked features. Tag and outline Annual, and add "67% savings over the Monthly Plan". Monthly gets an outlined button. Every button starts a 7-day free trial. Type: Inter, bold headlines at -2% tracking, regular body. Colors: white #FFFFFF (60) for cards, stone grey #746A61 (30) for the page, bright blue #0066EE (10) for the tag, outline and buttons. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
